-73.97900,40.61660.name: Genesis Fertility & Reproductive Medicine
-73.97900,40.61660.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Richard V. Grazi, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-0.47834,52.65361.name: Bourn Hall Stamford Fertility Health Suite, At The Broad Street Practice
-0.47834,52.65361.company: Satellite clinic to Bourn Hall Clinic
-0.47834,52.65361.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. Satellite clinic to Bourn Hall Clinic. A satellite is where patients are seen; the licence sits with the parent clinic, so the regulator's paperwork and the treatment are in different places. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

-122.54700,37.90600.name: Revive & Restore
-122.54700,37.90600.desc: A conservation non-profit applying biotechnology to endangered species — cloned black-footed ferrets and Przewalski’s horses, biobanking, and work toward genetic rescue of populations too inbred to recover on their own. It occupies an awkward and useful position: the same techniques the rest of this map documents being used by people whose stated aim is to undo damage rather than sell a product. Whether that distinction survives contact with scale is the open question, and this is where to watch it.

8.72800,47.49790.name: Bucher / agricultural machinery and data
8.72800,47.49790.desc: Agricultural machinery that records field conditions as it works, feeding the same data streams the seed companies collect. Machinery makers and seed companies are now competing for the same asset — a continuous record of what was planted, sprayed and harvested on each field — and whoever holds it can price inputs to each farm individually.

-74.01000,40.71280.name: International Flavors & Fragrances — Health & Biosciences
-74.01000,40.71280.desc: Engineered microbes producing enzymes, cultures and food ingredients at industrial scale, after absorbing DuPont’s nutrition and biosciences division in 2021. Between this company and Novonesis, most of the world’s industrial fermentation capacity sits in two sets of hands.

-117.16200,32.88960.desc: A contract research and services company founded in 2012 that sells genome editing to fish breeding companies, and holds patents covering the use of editing to induce reproductive sterility and control sex in aquatic species. It states a sterility-first rule: sterility is a precondition for adding any further edits, on the reasoning that farmed fish which reach open water should not be able to breed with wild ones or establish populations. Read that alongside the fluorescent zebrafish now breeding in Brazilian creeks and it is the same problem answered two ways — one by a pond wall, one by editing the animal so the wall matters less. It also sells sex control, because male tilapia and Atlantic salmon grow faster, which is a commercial reason travelling in the same construct as the containment one.
